intro.text: An ardent and expert on gemstones and spren, held in high esteem by Navani Kholin.

items.text: Rushur attended the feast at the Kholinar palace on the night Gavilar was assassinated, talking about gemstones and spren with another ardent and a bored Aesudan, and holding a small box painted with a flower. Navani, angry that Gavilar hadn't told her he was coming, suspected he was there because of Gavilar's strange spheres.
